projection: Recursive locator substitution and omission of filesystem identity tuples. Source hashes bind retained local originals; this public projection cannot reconstruct omitted locators or identities.

record.authority_boundary: Only candidate module, attempt ledger, snapshots, and candidate execution logs may be written. Frozen task/judge/baseline unchanged. The shared-filesystem role contract is not isolation from a malicious OS actor.

campaign.per_process: Frozen judge contract: 600 s, Lean allocator -M4096 and sampled process-group RSS cap 4 GiB, 4 MiB per stream; sampled RSS is not an OS hard limit.
campaign.registration: Register the campaign and every child before code compilation or judge access. Each tested source gets an immutable snapshot and digest.
campaign.selection_rule: First complete accepted candidate; no selection among numerical or empirical outcomes. Coordinator runs the frozen cosmetic-semantic positive after selection.
campaign.stopping_rule: Stop candidate editing at the first source that passes normal and optimized complete judges, or at any budget limit. Preserve all tested snapshots and receipts. A failed or timed-out run is not a pass.

record.candidate_payload: Candidate.lean with exactly the frozen thirteen ordered public theorem targets; private helpers allowed by the frozen source policy
record.scope: Deterministic formal development only. No estimator, calibration, novelty, source-correspondence closure, or mainline publication credit.
record.storage_boundary: Verified local preimages and results only until the permitted packet is committed, pushed, accepted on main, and retrieval is verified.
